Name: Joja Worship Center (Altar of Yoba Replacement)
Author: LeelooStardew
Description:
Joja Worship Center replaces the Yoba altar area inside Pierre’s General Store with a Joja-themed worship space.

The altar features a gigantic gold Joja Cola statue, a gold cash register for non-refundable “donations,” and a suspicious Joja “bible”...(aka Joja catalogue).

The catalogue is functional too, because of course Joja found a way to sell you furniture during worship.

[b][size=4]New! Version 1.1 adds two Joja Worship Center cutscenes![/size]
[/b]One gives a suspicious peek at how the Worship Center ended up inside Pierre’s, and the other shows a few Joja customers embracing Joja’s newest and totally normal community space.

[b]Config Options:[/b]
-By default, the Joja Worship Center appears immediately on any save.
-After launching the game once, config.json will generate in your Stardew Valley Mods folder (not the Vortex staging folder).
-Change JojaMemberRequired to true if you want the Joja Worship Center to only appear after buying a Joja Membership.

[b]Requirements[/b]:
SMAPI
Content Patcher

[b]Replaced or Edited Assets:
[/b]Altar of Yoba
Wallpaper behind the altar
Curtain behind the altar
Gold pillars around the altar
Stools in the worship area
Altar interaction text
Functional Joja catalogue 

[b]Compatibility:
[/b]If you use another interior recolor, this mod will try to overwrite the assets listed above, but it should not affect the rest of the interior.
Tested and confirmed compatible with DaisyNiko’s Earthy Interiors.
